claims.text: COMPOSE_PROFILES=llamacpp ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH -- it un-gates the service but does not route to it. The gateway defaults to PRIMARY_URL=${PRIMARY_URL:-http://vllm-primary:8000} (fleet/docker-compose.yml:1715), so a deployment that merely sets LLAMACPP_* + COMPOSE_PROFILES would start vllm-primary AND probe it, silently testing the incumbent Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 instead of Flash-Next. Routing is derived from the composed cortex model being a llama.cpp CATALOG GEAR (shape_render.py:189, LLAMA_CPP_ACTIVATION_ENV maps cortex -> llamacpp-primary and renders PRIMARY_URL + PRIMARY_SERVED_NAME). The separate deployment must therefore be rendered from a profile/shape whose cortex gear is the llama.cpp entry -- not hand-set env keys -- and vllm-primary must be absent from it, not merely unused.
